'''''Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon'' 81''' is the eighty-first issue of ''[[Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon]]''. The issue included the mandibles for the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'' model.

==Contents==
*'''[[Starship Fact File]]''': [[Hyena-class Droid Fighter/Bomber|''Hyena''-class bomber]] {{C|by [[Mark Newbold]]}}<ref name="Newbold" />
*'''[[Guide to the Galaxy]]''': [[Nal Hutta]] and [[Nar Shaddaa]] {{C|by [[Tim Veekhoven]]}}<ref name="SM" />
*'''[[Secrets of Spaceflight]]''': Going to Ground
*'''[[Build the Falcon]]''': Mandibles
